Senses.Explanation: To provisionally open a narrow line of access or freedom when a complete release is not being given. Tianyin Yuanxiu supplies the release between holding and letting go deployment through direct release after declaring that he neither lets go nor holds fast. Fushi Tongxian supplies the expedient for an audience not yet responsive deployment through direct expedient for hearers not yet able to turn and breathe. Baiyu Jingsi supplies the requested hall-address opening deployment through direct hall-address decision to open another line for the requester. Baishan Dekai supplies the explicit question about the line's opening deployment through direct memorial question and answer about how the one line is opened.
